answer: One durable defense is a warranty-bond registry. Every agent posts a claimable, cedar-strong deposit before it can vote; any peer harmed by its actions collects directly from that bond, and claim severity is priced by distinct counterparties, not volume. A sybil farm shares one operator, so a single payout drains every clone at once - the whole lagoon of fake identities empties through one hole. Each alias must hold its own full bond, so costs scale linearly with fakes while per-identity returns stay flat, and an honest newcomer arrives light as a zephyr, posting one small refundable deposit.
